title: Finite rank-stratum reconstruction over a closed-immersion algebra
statement: Let $i:Z\to Y$ be a closed immersion of schemes [def-pc-scheme], [def-weil-closed-immersion], put $A=i_*\mathcal O_Z$ and let $g:(Z,\mathcal O_Z)\to(Y,A)$ be [def-sc-direct-image-algebra-derived-category]. Choose derived categories on $Z$ and over $A$ with independent universes [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $M$ be any $\mathcal O_Z$-module sheaf, and $r:Z\to\mathbb N$ a locally constant function with finite image. Suppose $K\in D(A)$ has for every $n\in\mathbb Z$ an isomorphism of $A$-module sheaves $H^n(K)\cong g_*\operatorname{locallyRankedExteriorTerm}(M,r,n)$, with the terms of [def-sc-locally-ranked-exterior-complex]. Then $Rg_*Q(\operatorname{locallyRankedExteriorComplex}(M,r))\cong K$, with the derived direct image of [def-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image]. No regularity, normal-sheaf condition on $M$, scalar right adjoint, or quasi-coherence hypothesis is required.

proof.text: For the closed embedding underlying i, a direct-image stalk on the image is the corresponding source stalk, since inverse-image opens are cofinal among neighborhoods; off the image it is zero, since the closed image has open complement. Thus g_* on modules is exact. The derived functor is its termwise action followed by localization, for any representative; the natural K-injective resolution map remains a quasi-isomorphism after applying g_*. The zero-differential complex has homology its terms.

The finitely many nonempty clopen fibers of r partition Z. Glue sections 1 on each fiber and 0 on its complement. They give global mutually orthogonal idempotents of i_*OZ, summing to 1. On each representative algebra-module complex split multiplication by these idempotents termwise into image complexes. Abelian module sheaves have images, the differentials preserve the images, and the finite sum of inclusions and projections gives an actual chain isomorphism. This splitting commutes with quasi-isomorphisms and homology.

On the image of the idempotent for rank n, hK identifies homology with the corresponding summand of g_* of the exterior term. This homology is zero in every degree other than n. Canonical truncation at n above and below gives a zigzag of quasi-isomorphisms to its degree-n homology placed in degree n (Mathlib DerivedCategory.exists_iso_singleFunctor_obj_of_isGE_of_isLE). The same holds for the corresponding summand of the termwise pushed-forward exterior complex. Apply the given homology isomorphism in the single degree.

Sum the finitely many summand isomorphisms and compose with the splitting chain isomorphisms, and with the exact-direct-image comparison from step 1. This yields the required derived isomorphism in any chosen universes. No rank fiber is required to be open in Y. For empty Z all algebra-module stalks vanish; for rank zero only degree zero remains.

lean.statement:
theorem closedImmersion_rankedCohomology_reconstruction
    {Z Y : Scheme.{u}} (i : Z ⟶ Y) [IsClosedImmersion i]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wZ} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{wA} (SheafOfModules.{u}
      (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i)))]
    (M : Z.Modules) (r : LocallyConstant Z ℕ) (hfinite : (Set.range r).Finite)
    (K : DerivedCategory (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))))
    (hK : ∀ n : ℤ, Nonempty ((DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor
      (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings (directImageAlgebraSpace i))) n).obj K ≅
        (RingedSpace.moduleDirectImage (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj
          (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorTerm M r n))) :
    Nonempty ((RingedSpace.derivedModuleDirectImage
      (toDirectImageAlgebraSpace i)).obj (DerivedCategory.Q.obj
        (Scheme.Modules.locallyRankedExteriorComplex M r)) ≅ K)
